verse.verse_1: There hath asked an asker for the torment about to befall.
verse.verse_2: The infidels, of which there is no averter.
verse.verse_3: From Allah, Owner of the ascending steps.
verse.verse_4: Whereby the angels ascend Unto Him and also the spirit, On a Day whereof the measure is fifty thousand years.
verse.verse_5: Wherefore be thou patient with a becoming patience.
verse.verse_6: Verily they behold it afar off.
verse.verse_8: It shall befall on a Day whereon the heaven shall become like Unto dregs of oil.
verse.verse_9: And then the mountains shall become like Unto wool dyed.
verse.verse_10: And not a friend shall ask a friend,
verse.verse_11: Though they shall be made to see one another. Fain would the guilty ransom himself from the torment of that Day by his children.
verse.verse_12: And his spouse and his brother.
verse.verse_13: And his kin that sheltered him.
verse.verse_14: And all who are on the earth; so that this might deliver him.
verse.verse_15: By no means! Verily it is a Flame.
verse.verse_17: It shall calll him who turneth back and backslideth.
verse.verse_20: When evil toucheth him, he is bewailing.
verse.verse_21: And when good toucheth him he is begrudging.
verse.verse_23: Who are at their prayer constant.
verse.verse_24: And those in whose riches is a known right.
verse.verse_25: For the beggar and the destitute.
verse.verse_26: And those who testify to the Day of Requital.
verse.verse_27: And those who are fearful of their Lord's torment -
verse.verse_28: Verily the torment of their Lord is not a thing to feel secure from.
verse.verse_29: And those who of their private parts are guards.
verse.verse_30: Save in regard to their spouses or those whom their right hands own; so verily they are not blameworthy -
verse.verse_31: And whosoever seeketh beyond that, then it is those who are the trespassers
verse.verse_32: And those who of their trusts and their covenant are keepers.
verse.verse_33: And those who stand firm in their testimonies.
verse.verse_34: And those who of their prayer are observant.
verse.verse_35: Those shall dwell in Gardens, honoured.
verse.verse_36: What aileth those who disbelieve, toward thee hastening.
verse.verse_37: On the right and on the left, in companies?
verse.verse_38: Coveteth every man of them, that he shall enter the Garden of Delight?
verse.verse_39: By no means! veriiy We! We have created them from that which they know.
verse.verse_40: I swear by the Lord of the easts and the wests, that, vierly We are Able.
verse.verse_41: To replace them by others better than they; and We are not to be outrun.
verse.verse_42: Wherefore let thou them alone plunging in vanity and sporting until they meet their Day which they are promised.
verse.verse_43: The Day whereon they shall come forth from the sepulchres hastily, as though they were to an altar hurrying.
verse.verse_44: Downcast shall be their looks; abjectness shall overspread them. Such is the Day which they are promised.
